input.todayNote: 2026-05-05: Patient c/o ongoing heavy periods and pelvic pressure. She states, 'My periods are so heavy for five days every month that I feel exhausted, and I have a constant dragging feeling in my lower tummy, but I do not bloat outside my period and I have no waterworks issues or early fullness.' Examination shows abdomen is soft and non-tender with no palpable masses or ascites. Hx of heavy menses. Pelvic US from last month showed uterine fibroids with clear ovaries and no free fluid. She is a lifelong non-smoker, takes tranexamic acid and mefenamic acid, and has no family history of breast or ovarian cancer. Referral sent for gynaecology review regarding symptomatic fibroids.
